packageRules.description: The title of a pull request and its commit say which version replaces which, which is what the mails show
A new digest of the same tag has no version to show
Cilium carries the network of every pod and is synchronised by hand: its updates are pull requests that are merged by hand

Talos Linux and Kubernetes carry every node of the cluster: their updates are pull requests that are merged by hand, and the next run of full-updates.yml applies the merged version. The patch versions of Talos are the exception, below

A patch version of Talos is merged by itself: full-updates.yml applies it one node at a time, checking the cluster before and after each. Kubernetes is not in this rule, since upgrade-k8s has not been used for an update yet
The dump job has the Postgres major version of the server of nfs101, which is changed by a dump and a restore and not by a bump of a tag
The Semaphore of the cluster is bumped by update-semaphore-bck.yml, which commits the new tag of the latest release of its major line, and Argo CD deploys it

customManagers.description: The version of Talos Linux that talos-updates.yml installs on the nodes
The version of Kubernetes that kubernetes-updates.yml brings the cluster to
